description: This is a C source file implementing functionalities related to Multi-Link Devices (MLDs) in Wi-Fi networks. It includes functions for managing MLD state, creating and deleting associated objects, updating configurations, handling MLD events, and retrieving statistics, all within the context of a Wi-Fi software system.

classes.name: wld_mld
classes.description: Represents a Multi-Link Device (MLD) instance managing multiple SSID links and associated objects.

classes.name: wld_mldLink
classes.description: Represents a link (connection) in the MLD, including associated objects and runtime data.

methods.name: bool wld_apMld_areAllBssEnabled(int32_t mldUnit)
methods.description: Checks if all BSS instances associated with a specific MLD unit are enabled.

methods.description: Retrieves affiliated station info for a specific MAC address within an MLD unit.

methods.name: bool wld_apMld_getActiveApAffiliatedStaInfo(wld_apMld_afStaInfo_t * info,T_AccessPoint * pAP,swl_macBin_t * mac)
methods.description: Gets active affiliated station info for a MAC address on a specific access point.

methods.name: bool wld_apMld_hasSharedConnectionConf(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Verifies whether the AP MLD link has shared SSID and security configurations.

methods.name: void wld_apMld_notifyChange(wld_mld_t * pMld,wld_mldChangeEvent_e event,const char * reason)
methods.description: Handles notifications for MLD events such as addition or removal.

methods.description: Creates one or more AffiliatedAP objects in the Data Model for a given MLD link.

methods.name: amxd_status_t wld_apMld_deleteAffiliatedAPObjects(wld_mldLink_t * pStartLink)
methods.description: Deletes all AffiliatedAP objects associated with a specific MLD link starting from a given point.

methods.name: amxd_status_t wld_apMld_clearMld(wld_mld_t * pMld_internal)
methods.description: Clears runtime fields in the MLD's Data Model object, typically after unconfiguring.

methods.name: void s_update_affAP_MloStats(amxd_object_t * const obj,wld_mloStats_t * stats)

methods.description: ORF callback for reading MLO statistics of an affiliated AP.

methods.description: Updates runtime fields of an AffiliatedAP object based on link info.
